ak_hsip_2025.title: Alaska Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) Handbook

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.page: Appendix A, 'Crash Cost Derivation for Analysis of FFY '25 HSIP Projects' (updated 1/31/2025), PDF p. 39, column 'Adjusted Costs-Rounded (Use for Analysis)'
rules: one cost per KABCO level, per crash, every location type

DOT&PF's proportioned costs (FHWA 2021 unit costs inflated to 2024 dollars, then spread by the 2019-2023 crash mix 'to reduce the impact of random severe crashes'): a fatal crash is priced at $2,986,000, not FHWA's $14 million
U (injury, level not reported) unpriced; the portal always gives a KABCO level

statewide_rates.missing: not published: the HSIP Handbook (24th ed., §2.2, PDF p. 11) says the Roadway Safety Engineer sends 'updated average crash rates' to the regions each January, but no table is public (checked 2026-11-08)

screening.state_method: DOT&PF's HSIP sliding-window screen that ranks spots and segments by crash cost per mile (HSIP Handbook, 24th ed., §2.4, PDF pp. 11-12)

min_years.page: Appendix A-2 benefit/cost worksheet, PDF p. 25 ('No of years of crash analysis 5')
min_years.note: a worksheet input for HSIP benefit/cost, not a stated minimum for studies

spf_calibration.missing: DOT&PF publishes no SPF calibration factors (checked the HSIP Handbook, 24th ed., 2026-11-08); no SPF engine
